description: EXPERIMENTAL ONLY: Oriel Notch setup via a bounded installer script.

script: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $setup -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Oriel setup executable was not found in the Scoop version directory.' }
if (-not $process.WaitForExit(45000)) { Stop-Process -Id $process.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; throw 'Setup timed out after 45 seconds; arguments may be unsupported or require UI.' }
if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "Oriel setup exited with code $($process.ExitCode)." }

notes: Experimental only. --silent and --install-dir are unverified. Process timeout is 45 seconds.
